mapper.insert: INSERT INTO home_banner (id, title, image, link_url, sort_order, status, gmt_created, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{image}, #{linkUrl}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified})
mapper.update: UPDATE home_banner SET status = #{status}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM home_banner ORDER BY sort_order ASC, gmt_created DESC
